workflow_runs.display_title: test: add dedicated integration coverage for idempotent COM APIs

head_commit.message:
test: add dedicated integration coverage for idempotent COM APIs

Cover repeated offer, stop, discovery, subscribe and unsubscribe calls
with observable service-state checks and recovery. Require the test
application to exit zero. Correct copyright checker filesystem inputs
in a separate utility change; inherited findings remain documented.

Relates to eclipse-score/communication#1167.
